TAA accumulates them into soft tufts (~0.1-0.4 ms at 1080p); MSAA x4 removed only ~80 %. Applies to the MainCamera in Play Mode; batch-mode runs keep SMAA unless -desertTaa 1.
TAA contrast-adaptive sharpening (0.5 brought back grain on the grass slopes)

(Human readable name of the action. Must be unique within its action map (case is ignored). Can be changed without breaking references to the action.
dDetermines how the action triggers.
A Value action will start and perform when a control moves from its default value and then perform on every value change. It will cancel when controls go back to default value. Also, when enabled, a Value action will respond right away to a control's current value.
A Button action will start when a button is pressed and perform when the press threshold (see 'Default Button Press Point' in settings) is reached. It will cancel when the button is going below the release threshold (see 'Button Release Threshold' in settings). Also, if a button is already pressed when the action is enabled, the button has to be released first.
A Pass-Through action will not explicitly start and will never cancel. Instead, for every value change on any bound control, the action will perform.
.m_ExpectedControlLayout
Unique ID of the action (GUID). Used to reference the action from bindings such that actions can be renamed without breaking references.
Path of the control to bind to. Matched at runtime to controls from InputDevices present at the time.
Can either be graphically from the control picker dropdown UI or edited manually in text mode by clicking the 'T' button. Internally, both methods result in control path strings that look like, for example, "<Gamepad>/buttonSouth".

\Unity.Modules.SceneTemplateEditor.Tests.Editor
2Little Prince/Web Chapter
WebChapter
Scenes to put in the build for this chapter, in load order (a chapter may have more than one).
VOn = each scene gets its own pack, so entering the chapter downloads only the first scene's; the level prefetches the later ones while the first plays and loads them at its own scene change. Off = the chapter's scenes share one pack. Assets both scenes use are then packed into each (more download).
Per-chapter texture size caps for the web build, matched by a path fragment (optional).
lPath fragments of textures the web import rules must leave at full size: data maps the code samples (distance fields, zone maps), not pictures. Matched by Contains on the asset path.
Folders (inside this chapter's own Assets/Levels/<Scene> folder) whose textures the chapter loads at runtime by address, e.g. a loading page's pictures that must outlive the scene that brought the page up. Each texture becomes its own entry in <atlasId>_assets, its address its asset path. Textures only: the sync fails on anything else in them, or on anything that carries a material or shader.
（WEB_LOAD.md 
进 <atlasId>_hires 
。build.sh --no-texture-tier 
A fragment of the asset path; a texture whose path contains it gets this cap.
zMaximum texture size for the web import of matching textures.
